description: Keeps the GitHub Actions pinned in the composite actions and workflows, the pinned ponytail plugin marketplace and the pinned Renovate image up to date. Only those are managed here.

customManagers.description: Pinned versions annotated with a `# renovate:` comment: marketplace checkouts (`ref: <sha> # <tag>`) and the Renovate image (`renovate-version: <version>@<digest>`)
